one_off_payments.what: Milestone payments (net of VAT) to contract manufacturer BiBo to secure commercial manufacturing capacity for pegozafermin. The filing gives this for the nine months ended Sept 30, 2024, so the share paid inside the Apr-Sep burn window is not confirmed.
one_off_payments.quote: The net loss was driven by milestone payments of $81.0 million (net of applicable value-added tax) made to our contract manufacturing partner, BiBo

financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants (prospectus supplement dated Nov 12, 2024). The excerpt gives expected net proceeds and no explicit closing date, so the date is the 8-K filing date.
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The net proceeds from the Offering are expected to be approximately $118.4 million, after deducting the Underwriters’ discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses.

warrants.quote: the Company issued warrants to purchase 51,204 shares of the Company’s common stock, which remain outstanding as of September 30, 2024. The warrants became exercisable from the date of issuance and have a term of ten years with an exercise price of $9.76 per share
the Company issued warrants to purchase up to 406,951 shares of the Company’s common stock at an exercise price of $7.3719 per share that expire 10 years from the date of issuance.
